run_viewer_server: run a FastAPI server to serve the repoprover trajectory viewer on a configurable port and directory
list_run_directories: list all run directories with metadata and summary stats from session JSONL files
load_session_events: load session JSONL events and extract summary statistics for a given run directory
list_agents_in_run: list agent IDs and metadata in a run without loading full dialog content
get_pr_timeline: get all chronological PR lifecycle events for a specific agent including reviews and merges
